execution.start_gate: User explicitly authorized subagents to execute all tickets and the main agent to integrate and test on 2026-10-29; tracker setup/publication remains deferred and does not block this authorization.
execution.frontier_rule: An authorized ticket is runnable only when every blocker is complete and integrated, and the ticket has no active owner.
execution.parallelism: Use available agent slots for runnable tickets; DAG levels are examples, not global barriers.
execution.completion_rule: Acceptance criteria pass, evidence is recorded, and the change is integrated into the development branch.
execution.shared_changes: Coordinate shared command/config/contracts edits and integrate independent branches sequentially.
execution.server_resource_rule: Serialize environment mutations, real CPU training, and full preprocessing on the shared server; parallel development does not imply concurrent heavy server jobs.
execution.formal_gpu_runs: Deferred beyond this delivery; four formal configurations remain serial when later authorized.
